audit.reasoning: Piro (Kiowa-Tanoan) went extinct c. 1900 and its entire record is Bartlett's 1850s ~180-word list, Mooney's unpublished 1897 ~105-word marginalia, one Lord's Prayer in Spanish orthography and place names; Glottolog lists no grammar, phonology or sketch, and Sutton 2014 (held, pp. 5, 210-216) confirms no grammatical sketch is possible and that Harrington 1909 remains the best analysis, with Leap 1971 (classification) the only later publication. The record's deciding quotations from Harrington 1909 and Bartlett & Hodge 1909 are verbatim in the held djvu texts; the only defect is a minor locator slip (Harrington's list of Piro sources is on p. 567, not pp. 564-565). not determinable / domain not stated by the source with grade open-text is the correct and final coding; optionally fix the locator to 'Harrington 1909 p. 567' and, as the second reader suggested, replace the domain_quote (a line from Harrington's Tiwa/Te
